title: PresenceCacheResource.record does not treat addr as IPv6
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py PresenceCacheResource.record / evict / snapshot

Spec 18.5.2 cache entries use IPv6 addr (example 0200:...:1111). record() only validates via PresenceCacheEntry.from_mapping, and _require_addr accepts any non-empty string. The dict is keyed on that raw string.

Consequences:
- "0200::1111" and "0200:0:0:0:0:0:0:1111" (and case variants) are distinct peers; GET/Observe emit duplicates.
- evict() must be called with the exact recorded spelling or it is a no-op.
- Garbage or unbounded addr strings are stored and serialized to every observer.

Distinct from k208 (entry count / TTL) and 7gk6 (decoder nodes-array size). Fix belongs at record(): parse as IPv6 and store one canonical form.
acceptance_criteria: record() rejects non-IPv6 addr. Equivalent IPv6 spellings occupy one cache slot and evict() hits that slot. Tests cover compressed vs expanded form.
